d: This is Uttar Pradesh—a land where the ghats of Kashi and the sacred city of Ayodhya inspire profound faith, and where the grand Kumbh Mela is held in Prayagraj. It is home to the historic treasures of the Taj Mahal and Fatehpur Sikri, as well as the heroic legacy of Rani Lakshmibai at the fort of Jhansi. Here, the message of peace from Lord Buddha resonates in Sarnath, while the sweetness of Banarasi paan and Agra’s petha delights the senses. This is Uttar Pradesh—a place with so much to offer that you simply must discover it for yourself. So, join us as we journey through Uttar Pradesh,…
